subject: fix: set temp key-file attribute via File.SetAttributes
body:
fix: set temp key-file attribute via File.SetAttributes

Replace the bare `new FileInfo(path) { Attributes = ... }` statement
with `File.SetAttributes` — the discarded FileInfo instantiation tripped
SonarCloud S1848 (a reliability bug). Behaviour is unchanged.

Build clean; full suite 2003/83, identical to baseline.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

triage.rationale: Replaces redundant throwaway FileInfo instantiation with clean, direct File.SetAttributes call in two PuttyBase temp key generation paths.

votes.concern: The commit fixes Sonar S1848 in an absent helper; this fork's equivalent code is already warning-free and behaviorally identical.
votes.reason: It provides no correctness or stability gain; reimplementation would be churn because both APIs set the same attribute and current code has zero warnings.

votes.concern: No functional change; FileInfo.Attributes setter already applies the flag.
votes.reason: Original object-initializer already sets attributes on disk; pure idiom tweak, not a real fix.

dissent: codex: REJECT - It provides no correctness or stability gain; reimplementation would be churn because both APIs set the same attribute and current code has zero warnings.
grok: REJECT - Original object-initializer already sets attributes on disk; pure idiom tweak, not a real fix.
